jobs.title: Staff People Technology Specialist
jobs.description: Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond. We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better. JOB SUMMARY As our Staff People Technology Specialist, you'll be at the heart of our People function - managing Workday functional configuration while also supporting strategic initiatives. You'll partner cross-functionally with leadership, finance, and individual contributors to ensure our Workday system is effective, compliant, and aligned with our company direction. This role includes a key focus on payroll configuration , while also covering a broad spectrum of other functional areas. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Payroll Configuration Own the Workday Payroll configuration including requirements gathering, testing, and deployment Configure and maintain earnings, deductions, tax elements, accounting, and pay group setups within Workday Payroll Partner with Finance and outside payroll/tax vendors to ensure accurate, on-time payroll processing and reconciliation each cycle Support payroll compliance, including audits, tax filings, and multi-jurisdictional regulatory requirements Build and validate payroll testing scenarios for new configurations, tax updates, and system releases prior to go-live Lead resolution of defects and root cause analysis People Operations Maintain and continuously improve our Workday system, ensuring system fidelity and a strong end-user experience Manage security roles, business process configurations, and system permissions to protect sensitive employee data Document configuration decisions, processes, and standard operating procedures for the team Strategic Projects Serve as a trusted thought partner to stakeholders Stay current with HR trends and make proactive recommendations for continuous improvement Assist in organizational programs (workforce planning, organizational design, performance review cycles, etc) SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-growth setting High attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to handle sensitive information with discretion Excellent written and verbal communication skills EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in IT, Computer Science, or related field Five to seven years of experience in Workday configuration and maintenance, with two years specifically with Workday Payroll PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen Hearing and speech to communicate *This is a direct hire. Please, no outside Agency solicitations. Apptronik provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: Director, Wholesale Beauty
jobs.description: About The Company goop is a lifestyle platform dedicated to exploration, curation, and groundbreaking conversation. From its award-winning beauty and fashion lines to its expansive editorial lens, goop invites women to embrace the process of becoming, and to discover deep joy in the pursuit of pleasure, beauty, and growth in all phases of life. Gwyneth Paltrow began goop in the fall of 2008 as a weekly newsletter. It has expanded into a beauty, fashion, and food business that’s also known for its products, curation, podcast, TV shows, live events, and retail stores. ABOUT YOU You are a dynamic and driven sales professional with deep experience and passion for the beauty. You’re comfortable managing complex retail relationships, analyzing sales data, and building effective sales strategies. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are equally skilled at high-level business development and day-to-day operational execution. A team player at heart, you can lead, mentor, and jump in where needed to ensure smooth operations and achieve ambitious sales goals. Culturally, results are your native language— clear goals, clear numbers, a visible line from contribution to outcome. AI is integral to how you work, raising the bar on what a small group can accomplish. Authority sits comfortably within your working style: your scope is defined, and you exercise real decision authority. Founder mode isn’t a stage you are curious about; it’s how you operate. ABOUT THE ROLE As the Director, Wholesale, you will oversee goop Beauty’s wholesale business across domestic and international accounts, including key wholesale partnerships. You will manage sales operations, retail partner relationships, and business development initiatives while driving growth and maintaining goop’s brand integrity. This role requires a strategic thinker who is hands-on, detail-oriented, and adept at managing both client-facing and operational responsibilities. Serve as a primary point of contact for key wholesale accounts, ensuring strong relationships, consistent communication, and growth-focused account management. Manage communications to ensure continuity in service and account oversight across the team. Drive wholesale sales through direct selling to small and boutique accounts, expanding goop presence in domestic and international markets. Ability to build retailer plans which include but are not limited to; launch plans, marketing plans, education plans, promotional plans and sell through plans. Work cross functionally with marketing, creative, digital, product development and retail teams to ensure brand messaging and priority cohesion. Analyze sales reports, forecasts, and performance data to inform business decisions and improve account management strategies. Collaborate with Merch Planning and FP&A teams to ensure efficiency between inventory and financial planning Handle administrative tasks, back-office duties, and order management as needed to support seamless sales operations. Leverage prior experience with major retailers and international partners to navigate complex account structures and drive long-term growth. Lead, mentor, and develop junior team members, including serving as the primary manager for specialist support Supervise a team of field sales representatives and brand ambassadors QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE 8+ years of experience in wholesale sales or account management within the beauty, wellness, or consumer goods industries, minimum of 3 years of managerial experience Experience working with large domestic retailers, as well as international accounts Proven track record of managing and growing key retail partnerships, meeting sales targets, and exceeding revenue goals Strong understanding of retail operations, sales forecasting, and budgeting Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills Comfortable with CRM tools, sales reporting, and analytics platforms Experience managing and mentoring team members Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel Ability to work independently, multitask, and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment FAQ Compensation: $140,000 - $160,000 + Variable Incentive Compensation + Equity. This is a full-time, exempt role. Please note that this range represents the low and high end of the anticipated base salary range for the Los Angeles, CA based position. Goop, in good faith, reasonably expects to pay the position within this salary range. Goop provides the salary range in compliance with all applicable federal, state and local laws. The actual base salary will depend on numerous factors such as: experience, training, knowledge and skills, and if the location of the job changes. Benefits: Generous health benefits package, fertility benefits and paid parental leave. Perks: “goopcation” paid company summer break, generous goop discounts, special offers with brand partners, access to custom lifestyle resources and events, and a beautiful workspace in Santa Monica Work Philosophy: At goop we believe that creativity, innovation and camaraderie are essential to our business, our culture and our employee’s growth and development. For those in Los Angeles or New York we are in office a minimum of Tuesdays and Thursdays, with more days in office based on proximity. 100% remote candidates are also encouraged to apply. goop is an Equal Opportunity Employer. goop does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. All information provided by the applicant is collected, stored and processed in accordance with the terms of our CCPA Notice for Job Candidates. J ob Disclosures: No applicant disclosures related to physical requirements or ADA-related considerations are relevant for this role.

jobs.title: Sr. MarTech Manager, Communications
jobs.description: About the Role Chime has centralized MarTech as the shared technology foundation for all of Growth and Marketing. Web, communications and lifecycle platforms, ad tech, content and asset systems, experimentation, and AI marketing tooling now sit under one team — with a mandate to turn a stack of point solutions into a single growth engine. Chime is hiring a Senior MarTech Manager, Communications to evolve the technology that powers member communications across email, push, in-app, SMS and emerging channels. Reporting to the Director of Marketing Technology, you’ll serve as the MarTech lead for communications. You will bring deep expertise in Braze and the broader communications technology ecosystem, while also helping shape the broader cross-channel MarTech platform strategy. You’ll partner with Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Data teams to translate marketing and business needs into scalable solutions, optimize our technology stack, and unlock new capabilities. This is a senior individual contributor role combining technical depth, systems thinking, and cross-functional influence. You’ll work across platforms, integrations, data, vendors, and teams to solve complex problems and shape our comms tech evolves. The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $153,000 and up to $200,000. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience. In this role, you can expect to Serve as MarTech lead for Braze and the broader communications vendor ecosystem, managing integrations, audience syncing, and data flows and troubleshooting issues to ensure our messaging tech operates reliability and at scale. Partner closely with Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Data teams to translate business needs into technical requirements, identify capability gaps, and deliver scalable technology and automation solutions. Manage vendor relationships, performance, and roadmap alignment. Lead vendor evaluations and RFPs, pilot new capabilities, identify consolidation opportunities, and drive build-vs-buy recommendations. Identify and advance opportunities to apply AI across the communications operational workflow and marketing technology stack, from evaluating third-party capabilities to building and automating workflows. Drive greater value from our communications technology across orchestration, personalization, experimentation, audience activation, and content. Establish MarTech governance and best practices, including measures of platform health, integration reliability, data quality, adoption, and vendor performance. To thrive in this role, you have 8+ years of experience in marketing technology, CRM/lifecycle technology, product management, marketing automation or engineering, or a related technical field Deep hands-on expertise with Braze, including integrations, orchestration, personalization, data structures, and platform configuration. Strong understanding of communications technology architecture and technical fluency with APIs, schemas, events and triggers, integrations, identity and audience syncing, and data flows. Experience translating marketing needs into technical requirements, and partnering with and influencing Product, Engineering, Data, and/or vendors to deliver scalable capabilities. Experience managing strategic technology vendors and leading RFPs, pilots, and build-vs-buy assessments. Strong systems thinking and troubleshooting skills, with experience diagnosing communication failures across events, data, integrations, and platforms and driving issues to resolution. Strong cross-functional communication and influence, with the ability to bridge marketing and technical audiences. Experience evaluating AI-enabled capabilities and turning promising use cases into measurable pilots, workflows, or automations. #LI-Onsite #LI-AM1 A little about us At Chime, we believe that everyone can achieve financial progress. Through our user-friendly tools and intuitive platforms, we empower our members to take control of their finances and work towards their goals. Whether it's starting a savings account, purchasing a first car or home, launching a business, or pursuing higher education, we're proud to have helped millions unlock their financial potential. We are looking for someone with a passion for technology, strong problem-solving skills, and a commitment to continuous learning and collaboration. Job Responsibilities Design, develop, or maintain scalable business products Develop robust server-side logic and services using languages such as Python, Java, C#, or Node.js. Integrate with databases and manage data flows between front-end and back-end systems. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver products that meet business needs. jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Network Design & Optimization
jobs.description: Who we are Gatik, the leader in autonomous middle-mile logistics, is revolutionizing the B2B supply chain with its autonomous transportation-as-a-service (ATaaS) solution and prioritizing safe, consistent deliveries while streamlining freight movement by reducing congestion. The company focuses on short-haul, B2B logistics for Fortune 500 retailers and in 2021 launched the world’s first fully driverless commercial transportation service with Walmart. Gatik's Class 3-7 autonomous trucks are commercially deployed across major markets, including Texas, Arkansas, and Ontario, Canada, driving innovation in freight transportation. The company's proprietary Level 4 autonomous technology, Gatik Carrier™, is custom-built to transport freight safely and efficiently between pick-up and drop-off locations on the middle mile. With robust capabilities in both highway and urban environments, Gatik Carrier™ serves as an all-encompassing solution that integrates advanced software and hardware powering the fleet, facilitating effortless integration into customers' logistics operations. About the role Network Design & Optimization (NDO) is a highly cross-functional, strategic, and instrumental function within Gatik. The team is responsible for planning and maintaining networks / routes for Gatik’s Autonomous Vehicles (AVs). The NDO team provides the critical link between business and technical functions within Gatik. The team collaborates across various functions including Commercial, Engineering, Procurement, Operations, and Product. We are looking for an individual to become an integral part of this team. The individual will be responsible for leveraging their strong quantitative, strategic thinking and creative skills to help Gatik scale Freight-Only Operations and meet rising demands of our customers. The individual will work across functions, and enable the NDO team in meeting its broad mandate. In this role, your learning, growth and responsibility will be directly influenced by you. We are a small yet highly effective team where ownership, collaboration and communication skills are highly desired. If you are such an individual, we'd love to talk to you. This role is 5 days a week at our Santa Clara, CA office location. What you'll do Collaborate with a team of business, technical, product and operations individuals to design and optimize Gatik’s Autonomous Networks. Drive the implementation and scaling of tools, capabilities, and processes necessary to achieve goals of the NDO team. Analyze the network data of customers and prepare optimized networks and corresponding commercial proposals Structure complex problems, analyze large amounts of data, and deliver insights and recommendations to the Gatik leadership team. Support the B2B sales cycle including data analysis, network design, routing, scheduling and proposal drafting Lead end to end projects within Gatik and external stakeholders to collect and compile information in support of business strategy and operations. Explain business requirements to technical team members and ensure product development alignment with team vision and goals Conduct research and analysis of industry, company, customer, and channel data to support market assessment and identification of key trends / opportunities. Communicate analysis and recommendations to stakeholders including external senior executives by preparing presentations and identifying actionable insights What we're looking for Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related science discipline. MBA preferred. 5+ years of work experience in a strategic, analytical and/or customer facing role. Consulting, Banking, and/or a start-up experience preferred. Hands on experience problem solving and implementing scalable solutions to complex problems within a rapidly changing environment Proven ability to analyze data, develop creative solutions, and make sound decisions under pressure. Excellent proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Data analytics tools. Data modeling / scripting skills with Python strongly preferred. Comfortable using AI tools to automate workflows. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to effectively interact with stakeholders at all levels. Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and managing ambiguity, ability to multitask and prioritize conflicting demands. Salary Range - $170,000 - $220,000 More about Gatik Founded in 2017 by experts in autonomous vehicle technology, Gatik has rapidly expanded its presence to Mountain View, Dallas-Fort Worth, Arkansas, and Toronto. As the first and only company to achieve fully driverless middle-mile commercial deliveries, Gatik holds a unique and defensible position in the AV industry, with a clear trajectory toward sustainable growth and profitability. We have delivered complete, proprietary AV technology - an integration of software and hardware - to enable earlier successes for our clients in constrained Level 4 autonomy. By choosing the middle mile – with defined point-to-point delivery, we have simplified some of the more complex AV challenges, enabling us to achieve full autonomy ahead of competitors. Given extensive knowledge of Gatik’s well-defined, fixed route ODDs and hybrid architecture, we are able to hyper-optimize our models with exponentially less data, establish gate-keeping mechanisms to maintain explainability, and ensure continued safety of the system for unmanned operations. Visit us at Gatik for more company information and Careers at Gatik for more open roles.
